shortDefinition.en: The relative sizes and positions of scene elements as seen from the camera's viewpoint.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 从相机视点观察时，场景元素之间的相对大小和位置关系。

en: Cropping to a narrower field of view does not itself move the camera or change perspective.
zh-cn: 裁切成更窄视角本身不会移动相机，也不会改变透视。

example.en: Moving back to restore framing changes perspective because the camera position changed.
example.zh-cn: 为了恢复取景而后退时，透视因机位变化而改变。

sources.title: Depth of Field — Cambridge in Colour
sources.supports: The role of camera distance and framing in controlled photographic comparisons.
